text:
sana: quick check — after the terraform overlay change to how we render vault paths, our service secrets stopped rotating automatically. modified the path template to include environment and team, e.g. `secret/data/{{env}}/{{team}}/svc-creds` and now rotation webhook doesn't seem to pick up updates. anyone seen this pattern?

mike_lee: :eyes: do you have an example of the TF patch + the ExternalSecret manifest we serve? could be a mismatch between the path the controller watches and the path we write to vault.

sana: pasted snippets below — TF that sets the secret path and the k8s ExternalSecret we apply:

```hcl
# modules/vault/secret_mount.tf
resource "vault_generic_secret" "svc_creds" {
  path = "secret/data/${var.env}/${var.team}/svc-creds"
  data_json = jsonencode({ username = var.username, password = var.password })
}
```

```yaml
# k8s/external-secret.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: svc-creds
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation: "true"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1h"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-backend
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: svc-creds
  data:
    - secretKey: username
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/{{ .env }}/{{ .team }}/svc-creds
        property: username
```

lucy.ng: hmm — I think the ExternalSecret controller expects the exact KV v2 path key without `secret/data/` in the `key` field in some versions. try removing `secret/data/` and use `{{ .env }}/{{ .team }}/svc-creds` or switch to `versionedKey` syntax depending on controller version. also check the template interpolation — if those `{{ .env }}` vars are not rendered on the k8s side the remoteRef will be wrong.

kevin: +1 on controller compatibility. which external-secrets controller are we running? `kubectl -n external-secrets get deploy` should show image tag. If it's < 0.6.x we had to use `remoteRef.key` without `secret/` prefix. Also check the Vault role policy — if TF writes to `secret/data/...` and controller reads `secret/...` it'll 403.

sana: controller: `external-secrets/controller:0.7.1` per deploy. TF writes using KV v2 (we used path with `data/`). vault policy includes `path "secret/data/*" { capabilities = ["read","list"] }` so policy seems okay.

mike_lee: can you run one quick validation?

```bash
kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/external-secrets -- curl -sS localhost:8080/healthz || true
kubectl -n prod get externalsecret svc-creds -o yaml | yq .spec.data
```

mike_lee: that will confirm what remoteRef.key the controller has resolved. If the key includes raw `{{` syntax it means templating didn't run and our CI manifest generation might have missed injecting env/team.

sana: ran the `get` — remoteRef.key is showing literally `secret/data/{{ .env }}/{{ .team }}/svc-creds` so yes templating failed during render. our kustomize overlay replaced variables earlier but this particular manifest comes from the infra repo as a templated file that the deploy pipeline is supposed to render.

kevin: aha. pipeline bug then. two fixes: update CI to render template before `kubectl apply`, or switch to using ExternalSecret `provider/vault` with `objectMeta.annotations` that can be templated at ingestion. quick fix: manually patch the ExternalSecret to point to the rendered path to restore rotation.

lucy.ng: manual patch command if you want to test quickly:

```bash
kubectl -n prod patch externalsecret svc-creds --type merge -p '{"spec":{"data":[{"remoteRef":{"key":"prod/core/svc-creds","property":"username"}}]}}'
```

sana: I patched in prod with the rendered path and rotation resumed. logs show controller pulled vault change within ~40s and updated k8s secret. :thumbsup:

mike_lee: nice. for the longer term can we add a unit in the pipeline that validates no `{{` tokens remain in generated manifests? would catch this early.

kevin: agreed — I'll add a small `grep -R "{{`" check post-render in the deployment job and fail if any matches. also add a one-off migration job to re-render all ExternalSecrets in staging to catch similar TF-template drift.

sana: thanks team. I'll open the CI PR and link the prod patch here once it's in git.

ext steps checklist (quick):
- sana: PR to pipeline (render+validate) — in progress
- kevin: add grep guard in deploy job + staging migration — will do
- mike_lee: add a test to ops playbook for kv v2 path formats — follow up next week
